apps/web/app/api/auth/oauth/token/__test.reason: Expects 401 with data.error 'invalid_client'. Base route.ts returns {message: 'Unauthorized'} (401) for every failure; the description only mentions 'standard OAuth fields' and never states the error body shape, codes or statuses. It also needs the secret compared in code against client.clientSecret, because the mocked findFirst ignores a base-style where: {clientSecret: hashedSecret} filter.
